newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Oil Search says Kutubu share falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Oil Search says Kutubu share falls.

text.p: Papua New Guinea oil producer Oil Search Ltd said on Thursday its share of production from the Kutubu oil project fell to 779,100 barrels in the September quarter from 791,000 in the June quarter.
Operating revenue totalled A$18.33 million, down from A$21 million in the June quarter, based on oil liftings of 713,600 barrels compared with 842,000 in the prevous quarter.
However, the average realised oil price for sales in the quarter was US$20.15 per barrel, up from $19.68 previously.
Average daily oil production at Kutubu for the quarter was 109,802 barrels per day.

Kutubu participants are Oil Search with 7.763 percent, Chevron Niugini Pty Ltd 19.375 percent, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd unit BHP Petroleum (PNG) Inc 9.688 percent, BP Australia Ltd 19.375 percent, Ampolex 16.455 percent, Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd affiliate JPP 4.844 percent, and the PNG government 22.50 percent.
